psychological_meaning: Midnight Blue evokes feelings of calmness, sophistication, and mystery. It is often associated with intelligence, trust, and authority, lending a sense of formality and depth. This color can also inspire introspection and a feeling of peaceful contemplation, akin to gazing into a deep, star-filled night sky.

real_world_examples.title: Navy Uniform
real_world_examples.description: Many navy uniforms utilize a shade close to midnight blue to represent authority and discipline.

real_world_examples.title: Starry Night Painting
real_world_examples.description: The night sky in many artistic depictions, like Van Gogh's Starry Night, often features deep blues reminiscent of midnight.

how_to_pair: Pair with white for a crisp, clean look.
Combine with gold or silver for a touch of luxury.
Use with lighter blues for a harmonious palette.
Contrast with orange for a bold statement.
